title: Jaren dataflow graph 0.1
description: Structural grammar of an executable jaren-dag document (see packages/flow/docs/FLOW-FORMAT.md sections 6-7): named nodes from a closed kind vocabulary (input, output, const, query, jslt, task) wired by edges that carry data, with embedded Jaren JSON Query and JSLT documents composed by reference - register those published grammars alongside this artifact. This schema is structural validation only: the compiler remains authoritative for the wiring rules it cannot express - unknown node references, port completeness and uniqueness, acyclicity, the exactly-one-output rule and task-registry resolution are compile-time checks (JF0xxx), and unknown members are ignored for forward compatibility.

nodes.description: Node declarations, id to declaration. The id is what edges reference.

edges.description: The wiring: data flows from a node's result to a consumer's input scope, in document order for port-object assembly.

oneOf.description: Yields the run's input value (null when absent). Accepts no inbound edge.

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

oneOf.description: The run's result is this node's input scope value. Exactly one per document; no outbound edge.

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

oneOf.description: Yields its literal value. Accepts no inbound edge.

value.description: Any JSON value, delivered by reference.

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

oneOf.description: A Jaren JSON Query evaluated with $ bound to the node's input scope; an empty result yields null.

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

oneOf.description: A JSLT stylesheet transforming the node's input scope; an empty result yields null.

stylesheet.description: The stylesheet document (bare rule array or envelope form).

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

oneOf.description: A registered async handler, called as handler({ with, input }, signal); the handler must honor the run's shared AbortSignal.

version.description: Declared nonblank handler identity (FLOW-FORMAT section 7.8). The compiler requires it on every task in a workflow containing checkpoints, including recomputed tasks that can affect saved downstream results. The registry must supply the same token; identity is never derived from source.

with.description: Handler props: a query resolved against the node's input scope (null when absent or empty).

checkpoint.description: Opt-in durable checkpointing (FLOW-FORMAT §7.6): asserts this node's output is JSON-serializable; recorded values are seeded on resume instead of re-evaluated.

port.description: Names this delivery in the consumer's input-scope object; when any inbound edge of a node is ported, all must be, uniquely.

select.description: A query applied to the source value before delivery; an empty result delivers null.
